title: Review JobRouter security
description: Perform a security review of the JobRouter contract focusing on the state machine transitions, escrow accounting, and settlement math.
requirements: Familiarity with ERC-20 safe transfer patterns
Understanding of reentrancy and access control
deliverables: Critical/high issues filed as GitHub issues
context: JobRouter is the core state machine: createJob → accept → submitResult → approve/expire/cancel. It holds USDC in escrow and distributes via ValueSplit. Key areas: invariant I7 (escrow conservation), access control on each transition, edge cases around deadline handling, and the mutual cancel flow.
